QuestInfo.name: Specter Refining
QuestInfo.0: Go see #b#p9031002##k in #bArdentmill, the Crafting Town#k, and extract the minerals you need.
QuestInfo.2: #p9031002# refined the minerals. Go back and report to #b#p3001004##k.

0.0: Huh? Don't think I've seen you before. What brings you before the master of mining? \r\n#L0##bI have some tools. I want you to burn them and take the minerals out of them. Can you do that? #l\n#k
0.1: What a bizarre tool you have there. I can't wait to get a look at the components!

yes.0: I've got some refining to do! Why don't you go take in the sights. Or build something, if you're just going to stand there.

no.0: You ask for my help and then reject my offer?

1.0: These minerals are fascinating! I don't know who long it will take my masterful hands to deconstruct these at an atomic level, but if there's anybody that can do it, it's me. You say these came from Grandis?
1.1: I've got a runner that will deliver anywhere. I'll send the refined minerals to #p3001004# as soon as I've had my way with it.
1.2: I appreciate you bringing me a little slice of another world. Let me know if you ever need my services again!
